accepted_claims: Exact chamberwise cyclic infinitesimal module in the rational-isotropic orthogonal-pair subfamily, with trivial residual sl2.
Nonsplit rank-one extensions, simple essential oscillator socle, faithfulness without arithmetic product splitting, and length 2^r.
Correct shifted Casimir and first-/second-order annihilators.
Socle injection into the specified normalized principal series at parameter -1, with group injection on the oscillator globalization.
No nonzero intertwiner from the full module to ordinary smooth or distribution-vector principal series at any parameter when r>0.
Literal incompatibility of the extra WR15 ordinary-lowering kernel claim with the printed operator and error-function kernel.
interpretation_requirements: Arithmetic Weil-type modularity uses the source's integral/even lattice convention.
The algebraic socle map is infinitesimal; the Schwartz completion gives the group map.
Use the correctly normalized error-function/sign completion, not a verbatim transcription of the 2015 incomplete-gamma expression.
Distribution vectors mean the strong dual of the smooth contragredient; unrestricted smooth functions are excluded.

Full reconciliation of affected source statements.
Global intertwining maps, singular support/boundary-value interpretation, and analytic topology in a larger induced category.
Novelty and exhaustive current literature status.
scope_fields.analytic_scope: Chamberwise rational-isotropic orthogonal negative/isotropic-pair family under the integral-lattice convention; further data only conditional on a locally normally differentiable completed expansion.
scope_fields.arithmetic_convention: B(L,L) subset Z and q(L) subset Z for discriminant-Weil modularity; no arbitrary real-form arithmetic claim.
scope_fields.socle_map: Infinitesimal injection of the algebraic Hermite span; group injection only on its Schwartz oscillator globalization.
scope_fields.obstruction_scope: For r>0, zero Hom from the full cyclic module to every specified ordinary smooth or distribution-vector Jacobi principal series; not an obstruction in arbitrary localized, meromorphic, hyperfunction, or exponential-growth categories.
scope_fields.casimir_shift_retained: Omega_0=(k-n/2)(k-n/2-2)-2 C_{k,L}; the zero-normalized C does not kill every shifted descendant.
scope_fields.lowering_distinction: F_0 Theta=0 while ordinary F Theta is generally nonzero; literal extra source subspace assertion conflicts with printed formulas. No general refutation or full reconciliation of all source claims.
audited_expository_additions_included: Direct rational-ray convergence and finite-order differentiation majorant
Explicit ordinary-lowering Fourier coefficient and noncancellation argument

Rational-ray convergence and the explicit lowering coefficient are partial expository verifications. Global maps, singular support, analytic topology, irrational-isotropic coverage and full source reconciliation remain missing; prior Schrodinger-Weil interpretation is credited, and no full-target or novelty certificate is claimed.
